doc: A (2, 2) field with a (2, 1) float32 offset column and a (2, 2) subtexel: the offset broadcasts over the columns, subtexel present. Float32 inputs; tolerance as the typical case. Arguments: s, fine, target, streak, subtexel and offset are the inputs of that name when listed; an unlisted streak or offset (default 0.0) is the scalar in params, an unlisted subtexel is None; prm holds the GenParams fields compose reads. The 36 steps and the bracket [-10, 10] are literals of the source. Measured: promoting the float32 inputs to float64 changes the output by at most 5.2e-9; one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 1.0e-7 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is 46x the larger of the two spreads.
